description: Keeps CI pins fresh: Actions (by SHA) and the tool versions in the Makefile and lint-test.yml. Chart image defaults are not covered yet. Nothing automerges.

customManagers.description: helm-unittest plugin version in the Makefile
Helm version used by setup-helm in the workflows

packageRules.description: The Makefile pins a sha256 of each tool's checksums file; a version bump needs the new hash or CI fails on purpose
prBodyNotes: **Update the checksum pin too.** CI fails until the matching `*_CHECKSUMS_SHA256` in the `Makefile` is set to the sha256 of the new release's checksums file: `curl -fsSL https://github.com/yannh/kubeconform/releases/download/<version>/CHECKSUMS | sha256sum` or `curl -fsSL https://github.com/helm-unittest/helm-unittest/releases/download/v<version>/helm-unittest-checksum.sha | sha256sum`.
